final_text:
Short answer: I can’t find any NHANES variable named “LBXFAKE,” and ExposomeQL has no exposure or EP‑WAS associations under that code. It also doesn’t match any chemical in CompTox. If you can share the exact NHANES code (e.g., LBXPFOA) or the chemical name/CAS, I can pull its strongest associations with cycle-by-cycle details.

What I can show right now (closest match — PFAS measured in NHANES):
If by “perfluorinated diol” you meant common PFAS biomarkers that NHANES actually measured, here are the strongest, meta‑analytic EP‑WAS associations (model 6: age + age² + sex + ethnicity), with effect sizes and number of survey cycles contributing. Estimates are standardized betas from survey‑weighted regressions pooled across cycles.

- PFHxS (LBXPFHS; 8 cycles)
  - Serum albumin (LBXSAL): +0.161 (SE 0.0116), p=2.35e-06, FDR<0.05
  - Urine albumin (URXUMA): −0.148 (SE 0.0171), p=5.52e-05, FDR<0.05
  - RDW (LBXRDW): −0.146 (SE 0.0152), p=2.80e-05, FDR<0.05
  - Hemoglobin (LBXHGB): +0.111 (SE 0.0107), p=1.64e-05, FDR<0.05
  - Total calcium (LBXSCA): +0.108 (SE 0.0108), p=2.17e-05, FDR<0.05
  - Serum iron (LBXSIR): +0.096 (SE 0.0057), p=6.64e-07, FDR<0.05
  - Transferrin saturation (LBDPCT): +0.107 (SE 0.0063), p=0.00343, FDR<0.05

- PFOA (LBXPFOA; 5 cycles)
  - Urine albumin (URXUMA): −0.186 (SE 0.0118), p=9.30e-05, FDR<0.05
  - Serum albumin (LBXSAL): +0.177 (SE 0.0155), p=3.31e-04, FDR<0.05
  - RDW (LBXRDW): −0.158 (SE 0.0120), p=1.92e-04, FDR<0.05
  - Uric acid (LBXSUA): +0.111 (SE 0.0067), p=7.63e-05, FDR<0.05
  - Transferrin saturation (LBDPCT): +0.095 (SE ~0.035), p≈7.40e-04, FDR<0.05

- PFOS (LBXPFOS; 5 cycles)
  - Serum albumin (LBXSAL): +0.161 (SE 0.0141), p=3.36e-04, FDR<0.05
  - RDW (LBXRDW): −0.147 (SE 0.0143), p=5.03e-04, FDR<0.05
  - (Others near‑significant at FDR 5%: URXUMA −0.142; HGB +0.112; HCT +0.108)

- PFNA (LBXPFNA; 8 cycles)
  - Serum albumin (LBXSAL): +0.152 (SE 0.0157), p=2.63e-05, FDR<0.05
  - RDW (LBXRDW): −0.112 (SE 0.0196), p=7.18e-04, FDR<0.05
  - Bicarbonate (LBXSC3SI): +0.091 (SE 0.0148), p=4.54e-04, FDR<0.05
  - Urine albumin (URXUMA): −0.077 (SE 0.0108), p=1.86e-04, FDR<0.05
  - Serum creatinine (LBXSCR): −0.076 (SE 0.0153), p=0.00156, FDR<0.05

Notes on cycles:
- The “n_studies” above reflects the number of NHANES cycles included in each meta‑analysis (e.g., PFHxS results come from 8 cycles; PFOA and PFOS typically from 5 cycles). If you want, I can drill down to show the per‑cycle estimates for a specific PFAS–phenotype pair.

If you clarify the exact code or chemical (or confirm you meant one of the PFAS above), I’ll return the strongest associations for that analyte and list the specific survey cycles and effect sizes.
